basic_details.job_title: DBEE Yoga Trainer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Bureau of Employment and Enterprises, Pathankot needs one (01) Yoga Trainer (ਯੋਗਾ ਟ੍ਰੇਨਰ) on a purely temporary basis for a three-day yoga training camp for elderly residents of the old age home at Jhakholahri, District Pathankot. Self-attested documents must be submitted by hand at Room No. 352, Second Floor, District Administrative Complex, Pathankot, by 25 November 2026, 5 PM. The notice (No. DBEE/2026/667, dated 23 November 2026) is issued from the office of the District Employment Generation, Skill Development and Training Department (ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਰੋਜ਼ਗਾਰ ਉਤਪੱਤੀ ਹੁਨਰ ਵਿਕਾਸ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਖ

By hand (in person) at the office

content_sections.heading: About DBEE Pathankot
content_sections.text: The District Bureau of Employment and Enterprises (DBEE), Pathankot functions from the Second Floor, District Administrative Complex, Pathankot, under the District Employment Generation, Skill Development and Training Department. This engagement is part of the "Saade Bazurg Saada Maan Yojana" under the State Action Plan for Senior Citizen 2026-27. The three-day camp will train about 25-30 elderly people living in the old age home (Biradh Ashram) at Jhakholahri in yoga and meditation.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are submitted by hand only. Interested candidates can hand in self-attested copies of their documents at the following address by 25 November 2026, till 5 PM: Room No. 352, Second Floor, District Administrative Complex, Pathankot (office of the District Bureau of Employment and Enterprises). The notice does not prescribe an application form. No application will be received in the office after the deadline. The office can be contacted on 0186-2920071 and 7657825214, or by email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post of Yoga Trainer. The engagement lasts three days, with four hours of training per day. Educational qualification: Diploma in Yoga Training OR a 200-hour certified course in Yoga Training. Experience: one year of experience in Yoga Training (required in addition to the qualification above). Language: the candidate must have passed Punjabi at matriculation (10th) level. Age: the candidate must be at least 21 years old as on 01.11.2026. The notice gives no upper age limit. Pay: Rs. 1000/- per hour (Rs. 12000/- for three days). Place of training: Adarsh Biradh Ashram, Jhakholahri, District Pathankot. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: DBEE Pathankot Yoga Trainer Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the work the trainer will do during the camp: At the start of the camp, getting the elderly to do light exercises and talking with them about their daily activities. Making the elderly practise breathing exercises (such as Anulom-Vilom) and meditation for relief from stress. Conducting safe yoga asanas done while seated, to bring flexibility to the joints. Giving information on the use of yoga in daily life, the importance of a nutritious diet, and improving daily tasks through yoga. Any other activity as per instructions issued by the competent officer.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice (self-attested copies): Educational qualification Experience Identity proof

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be selected on the basis of a merit prepared after considering their educational qualification, relevant experience and an interview. The notice does not mention the interview date. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and only for conducting the three-day training. Applications will not be received in the office after the deadline. For any amendment or further information, candidates may consult the official website of District Pathankot.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DBEE Pathankot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) vacancy for the post of Yoga Trainer, on a purely temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DBEE Pathankot Yoga Trainer post?
faq.answer: Documents must be submitted by hand by 25 November 2026, till 5 PM. Applications are not received after the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Yoga Trainer post?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Yoga Training or a 200-hour certified course in Yoga Training, plus one year of experience in Yoga Training. Punjabi passed at matriculation (10th) level is compulsory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DBEE Pathankot Yoga Trainer post?
faq.answer: The candidate must be at least 21 years old as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Yoga Trainer?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 1000/- per hour, which comes to Rs. 12000/- for the three days.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DBEE Pathankot Yoga Trainer post?
faq.answer: Hand in self-attested copies of your educational qualification, experience and identity proof at Room No. 352, Second Floor, District Administrative Complex, Pathankot, by 25 November 2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Yoga Trainer be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be made on the basis of a merit prepared after considering educational qualification, relevant experience and an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DBEE Pathankot Yoga Trainer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and only for a three-day training camp, with four hours of work per day.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the yoga training camp be held?
faq.answer: The training will be held at Adarsh Biradh Ashram, Jhakholahri, District Pathankot, for about 25-30 elderly people living in the old age home.
